_about: SYNTHETIC test cases for copilot/checks/payer_check.py. Every member and plan is invented. Expected outputs are written by hand, not generated by the code.

cases.about: Billed the plan the member had on the date of service
Member in managed care on the date of service, billed fee-for-service

findings.explanation: On the date of service the member was enrolled in MEDICAID-MCO-A, a managed care plan, so the claim belongs there, not to MEDICAID-FFS.

notes: Send the claim to MEDICAID-MCO-A, and check that the provider is in its network.
